name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to an agreement covering the use of AI services, including model training, restrictions and IP/privacy terms.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate agreement governing a provider's handling of protected health information (PHI).

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for a provider's subscription cloud service (SaaS), including access, support, fees and liability.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Terms for processing personal data, covering processor/subprocessor roles and data protection obligations (e.g. GDPR).

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-stage design partners who get early product access in exchange for feedback.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, capturing purpose, term and party details.

name: Mutual NDA Standard Terms
description: Standard terms of the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement for two parties sharing confidential information.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement for professional services delivered under statements of work, with change orders and deliverable acceptance.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement between two parties setting out cooperation, obligations, payment and taxes for a business partnership.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Agreement for a time-limited trial (pilot) of a product before a full commercial commitment.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service levels for uptime and support response times, with remedies for missed targets.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing software to a customer for a subscription period.
